patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast color blocks define distinct content sections, creating a bold visual rhythm down the page.
Extreme typographic scale contrast, featuring massive, condensed sans-serif display headings against smaller, lighter body text.
A vibrant, high-saturation primary color palette (red, purple, green) is used in large, flat blocks, often paired with stark black or white text for maximum contrast.
The hero section features a large 'ORBIT' text element that dramatically scales up and parallaxes as the user scrolls, eventually filling the viewport before scrolling out.
The primary navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport and transitions from a transparent background to a solid black background upon scrolling.

technique_notes: To achieve the dynamic hero typography, a scroll-triggered animation library would be used to scale and position the large text element in response to scroll depth, creating a parallax and 'fill screen' effect. The circular graphic also uses a similar scroll-triggered transformation.

The sticky navigation bar is implemented by fixing its position to the top of the viewport and using a JavaScript listener to add a class that changes its background color and potentially other styles (like button visibility) once a certain scroll threshold is met.

Section breaks are visually emphasized by using full-width, full-height color blocks with distinct, high-contrast background colors, creating clear visual separation without relying on borders or shadows.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, condensed display headings (~8-10x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for most elements and section corners, with subtle rounding on interactive buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero and between major color-blocked sections, with balanced density for content within those sections.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of massive, animating typography in the hero section, combined with a high-contrast, full-bleed color blocking strategy that creates a powerful, almost brutalist visual impact. The dynamic scaling of the 'ORBIT' text is a memorable and unique interaction.
